description:
List every AI build tool Vibe Shipped tracks (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Windsurf, Rork, Base44...) with stats.

Use when: the user asks which AI build tools exist, or you need tool ids for other calls. For a ranking use top_tools; for 2-4 side by side use compare_tools.

Behavior: Read-only, no parameters. Per tool: what it is, best use, official pricing summary with checked date and source URL, number of listed apps, total and median stated monthly revenue of those apps, top apps, and new listings in the last 30 days.
